_about: Second held-out set, written from cause titles only, never from symptoms or keywords, then checked by hand. Never copy these into known-causes.yaml: they measure how the matcher handles wording it has not seen. 'expect' lists every cause or validation rule that fits equally well; empty means none covers it.
